definitions.explanation: Doing something with great care and attention to detail, leaving nothing to chance.

examples.japanese: {念入|ねんい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{念入|ねんい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She is doing her makeup carefully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{念入|ねんい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦チェックした→チェックする：04916_chekkusuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked my luggage thoroughly before departure.

notes:
{念入|ねんい}り is a na-adjective often used adverbially as {念入|ねんい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. It conveys the idea of being thorough and leaving no room for oversights.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {念入|ねんい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do something thoroughly/carefully)
- {念入|ねんい}りな～ (a thorough/meticulous...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {念入|ねんい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to verify carefully)
- {念入|ねんい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to clean thoroughly)
- {念入|ねんい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧ (to prepare meticulously)
- {念入|ねんい}りな⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (a thorough investigation)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧ (polite, careful) focuses on politeness and attentiveness. {念入|ねんい}り focuses more on being thorough and not missing anything. ⟦{入念|にゅうねん}→入念：20208_nyuunen⟧ has the same meaning with reversed kanji order and is slightly more formal.
